#!/bin/bash

START=$1
END=$2

if [[ ! $START =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ || ! $END =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
  exit 2
fi

if [[ $START == $END ]]; then
  echo 0
  exit 0
fi

if [[ $START > $END ]]; then
  START=$END
  END=$START
fi

HOLIDAYS=$(cat /app/holidays.txt | grep -E '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' | sort -u)

function is_weekend() {
  local date=$1
  if [[ $(date -d $date +%u) -eq 6 || $(date -d $date +%u) -eq 7 ]]; then
    return 0
  else
    return 1
  fi
}

function is_holiday() {
  local date=$1
  for holiday in $HOLIDAYS; do
    if [[ $date == $holiday ]]; then
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

function count_working_days() {
  local start=$1
  local end=$2
  local count=0
  local date=$start

  while [[ $date < $end ]]; do
    if ! is_weekend $date && ! is_holiday $date; then
      count=$((count + 1))
    fi
    date=$(date -d $date +1day)
  done

  echo $count
}

count_working_days $START $END
